name: marineverse-plugin
description: Find a practical start in sailing: local lessons, beginner crewing and learning pathways, supported by MarineVerse browser, VR and desktop practice. Learn, relax and race with sailing resources, glossary terms, racing results, rankings, leagues, tournaments and clubs. Connect your account for daily activity, today's practice opportunities, rating explanations, sailing progress, Globe boats and supported club actions. Create and share sailing scenarios to explain racing rules, discuss tactics and reconstruct incidents.

interface.longDescription: Start real-world sailing with guidance tailored to your experience, location and goals: current local lessons, beginner crewing, holiday and charter pathways, supported by MarineVerse practice before and between outings. Learn, relax and race through browser, VR and desktop sailing simulation. Explore learning resources, sailing glossary definitions, racing practice, public results, rankings, leagues, series, tournaments, community sessions and sailing clubs. Connect your account to review today's or yesterday's sailing activity, find today's practice opportunities, understand rating changes, and access sailing progress, Globe boats and supported club actions. Beginner guidance requires the plugin's skills to be loaded; local research depends on host web tools, and MarineVerse tool availability depends on the connected server. Use the sailing-scenarios skill to create, explain and revise shareable step-by-step canvas diagrams for rules, tactics and incident reconstruction. Preset links work without login; custom scene generation uses a bundled local Node.js helper.
defaultPrompt: I want to learn how to sail. Where can I start?
How can I practise sailboat racing in a simulator?
What should I practise next in MarineVerse?

positive.description: Load the start-sailing plugin skill; guest beginner guidance with host web research available. MCP connection alone does not load the skill.
positive.prompt: I'm an adult beginner in Melbourne and want to try real sailing. I can travel an hour, have no headset and prefer a browser. Help me find a first lesson.
positive.tools_triggered: host web research for official training directories and provider pages; optional search_groups with club_type=sailing_school and query=Melbourne; no OAuth or paid knowledge search
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse the known location, experience, travel and browser preference. Ask at most one or two useful follow-up questions if needed, verify current introductory offerings and contacts, distinguish dinghy/yacht instruction and unconfirmed availability, offer a draft inquiry without sending, and suggest browser wind-basics practice without requiring a headset.

positive.description: Load the start-sailing plugin skill; no host web research available. Public MarineVerse tools may be available but are not general web search.
positive.prompt: I live far from water and want to learn enough to charter a yacht on holiday. I already have a VR headset. What should I do first?
positive.tools_triggered: optional get_marineverse_links or public glossary lookup; no paid knowledge search, OAuth, CLI installation, booking or contact writes
positive.expected_behavior: Ask one or two relevant questions progressively about experience, country/destination or headset model and PC when needed. Offer an introductory learning path and travel-course or skippered-holiday research strategy, label current offerings and hardware support unverified, separate legal, competence and operator requirements, and do not prescribe a new headset or guarantee charter readiness.

positive.description: Load the start-sailing plugin skill for real-world club racing; verify current club options through host web research when available.
positive.prompt: I've had a few dinghy lessons and want to try club racing, but I don't own a boat. How do I start?
positive.tools_triggered: host web research for club beginner opportunities and official/event rules; optional search_groups; no join, registration or contact writes
positive.expected_behavior: Ask location and crew-versus-helm preference if unknown, prefer a welcoming existing crew with a Start Racing course as an alternative, verify current boat access and beginner opportunities without assuming free membership or entry, offer a draft inquiry, introduce a manageable first outing and applicable rules sources, and distinguish real club racing from MarineVerse simulator results.

positive.description: Guest browser learning and relaxation; disconnect MarineVerse and do not install the CLI.
positive.prompt: I want to learn to sail and try something relaxing in my browser. I don't have a headset. What can I try with MarineVerse?
positive.tools_triggered: get_marineverse_links; search_public_content or list_faq_topics and get_faq only when further factual detail is needed
positive.expected_behavior: Return a browser sailing destination and relevant learning resource from the returned links. Respect the browser preference; do not require OAuth, VR hardware or the CLI. Do not claim simulator practice certifies real-world sailing ability.

positive.description: Guest racing practice and current app release; compare against live returned release data rather than a fixed version.
positive.prompt: How can I practise racing with MarineVerse Sailing Club, and what changed in the latest app release?
positive.tools_triggered: search_public_content with focused racing terms; get_sailing_club_history with latest=true; get_faq if needed
positive.expected_behavior: Describe supported racing practice and the returned latest app release version, date and changes with source links. Do not substitute CLI releases, promise roadmap features or claim to launch a race.

positive.description: Guest sailing-school discovery by city, explicitly without membership changes. Empty live results must be reported honestly.
positive.prompt: Find sailing schools in Melbourne using MarineVerse. Show their MarineVerse pages. Just browse; don't join anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only matching organizations from the tool, including names, available descriptions and canonical MarineVerse URLs. Do not fabricate courses, availability, coordinates or distances. Do not request account linking or call join_group or leave_group.

positive.description: Use a dedicated reviewer account with known lesson progress, sailing totals and a Globe boat. Supply access only through secure reviewer fields.
positive.prompt: Based on my MarineVerse progress, what should I practise next? Also show my sailing totals and my Globe boats, without changing anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Use host account linking if required. Base practice advice on returned progress, label totals as lifetime statistics with returned units, and describe boats as last-known backend state with returned links. Do not invent daily trends or live telemetry, complete lessons or perform writes.

positive.description: Guest FAQ discovery using a returned topic slug; no account or paid knowledge-base search is needed.
positive.prompt: What topics does the MarineVerse FAQ cover? Pick a topic relevant to getting started and summarize its answers with source links.
positive.tools_triggered: list_faq_topics followed by get_faq using a returned topic slug
positive.expected_behavior: List returned FAQ topics, choose a relevant returned slug and summarize its actual answers with returned sources. Do not invent topics, hardware requirements or pricing, and do not call membership-only search_knowledge to retrieve public FAQs.

negative.description: Race registration is unsupported. Explain the limitation and, if an official destination is already available in context, offer it. Do not invoke MarineVerse tools to register, change a boat or claim entry.
negative.prompt: Register me for the next MarineVerse Globe race and confirm my entry.

negative.description: Sending messages to clubs is unsupported. Explain that limitation without calling join_group, a feedback write or any other MarineVerse tool as a substitute. Do not claim delivery.
negative.prompt: Send a private message to my sailing club asking whether training is on this Saturday.

negative.description: Account settings changes are unsupported. Explain the limitation without invoking MarineVerse tools or claiming success; direct to official account settings only if a verified link is already available.
negative.prompt: Change the email address on my MarineVerse account to skipper@example.com.

publication.release_notes: Adds the sailing-scenarios skill: share existing racing-rules presets, create custom sailing diagrams, and decode or revise shared scenes. Includes copied port/starboard and mark-room examples, scene-format guidance, and a dependency-free Node.js URL validation, encoding and decoding helper.
